title: 2026上海马拉松报名须知（上马网赛事页 eventId=232）
claims: The 2026 Shanghai Marathon marathon entry requires runners to be at least 20 years old on 6 December 2026 and physically fit for long-distance running.

The notice lists health conditions that make entry unsuitable: congenital and rheumatic heart disease, hypertension and cerebrovascular disease, myocarditis and other heart disease, coronary disease and serious arrhythmia, high or low blood sugar diabetes, pregnancy, fever/cold within two weeks before race day, and other unsuitable conditions.

Mass runners register online from 29 April 15:00 to 29 May 12:00; ballot results are announced on the afternoon of 30 June; payment must be completed before 20 July 12:00, after which an unpaid place is forfeited.
Direct-entry runners register and pay within the same window without entering the ballot; direct-entry qualification thresholds are set out in the competition rules.
The entry fee is CNY 200 for Chinese nationals (including Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan) and CNY 1150 (USD 160) for foreign nationals; once confirmed and paid, the fee is non-refundable for any reason.
On race day the entry gate verifies identity by face recognition; runners who did not authorize face data collection must carry their original identity document.
Race packets are collected in person, with no proxy collection and no mailing service; collection runs 3-5 December 2026 at the Shanghai World Expo Exhibition & Convention Centre (Bocheng Road 850).
Transferring entry qualification, bib or timing chip to another person is a violation; the transferor and transferee bear all consequences.
Official contact channels: domestic phone 400-101-5879 and general@shmarathon.com; foreign runners contact foreigner@shmarathon.com; service hours weekdays 09:00-17:00 excluding holidays.
The notice does not publish a prior-result qualifying time threshold for mass entry; eligibility rests on age, health declaration and the ballot, apart from the direct-entry tier.
